shots.narration: 这张黑白全家福,在我家相册里躺了五十年。你猜怎么着——她朝我眨眼了。
shots.visual: A restored 1960s Chinese black-and-white family portrait filling the full vertical frame, young woman in front center, vintage photo grain and slightly faded edges, warm soft light, nostalgic film texture; she suddenly blinks gently and the corners of her mouth lift into a subtle smile
shots.motion: First 2 seconds completely still (frozen photo), then subtle eye blink + micro smile, tiny slow zoom-in; soft camera shutter sound at the blink; caption "她朝我眨眼了"

shots.narration: 别急,三步就能让老照片活过来。第一步,修复:上色、磨皮、补细节,模糊的旧照一秒变清晰。
shots.visual: Split-screen vertical composition: top half a scratched blurry old photo, bottom half the same photo restored in natural color and sharp detail; clean tutorial screen-recording aesthetic, UI sliders adjusting color and clarity, bright neutral lighting
shots.motion: Wipe transition from damaged to restored version, color gradually bleeding into the black-and-white image; step label "STEP 1 修复" sliding in

shots.narration: 第二步,图生视频:把照片喂给AI,写一句提示词——"轻微眨眼,嘴角上扬"。记住,微动作最出效果,大幅动作容易穿帮。
shots.visual: Screen-recording style mockup of an AI image-to-video tool: a restored color portrait on the left, a text prompt box typing "轻微眨眼,嘴角上扬" on the right, then a generated video preview playing the subtle blink, dark modern UI, purple-blue accent glow
shots.motion: Typing animation of the prompt text, progress bar filling, then looping preview of the micro-motion result; step label "STEP 2 图生视频"

shots.narration: 第三步,合成:配上年代感的环境音,再加一段轻音乐,一条会呼吸的短视频就成了。
shots.visual: Vertical timeline editor mockup: video track with the animated portrait, waveform track showing ambient sound and gentle music layer, warm nostalgic color grading on the preview window, cozy dim workspace vibe with a cup of tea beside the laptop
shots.motion: Waveform bars animating with the audio, playhead sweeping across the timeline, preview window showing the portrait breathing softly; step label "STEP 3 合成"

shots.narration: 工具都摆在这儿了。但做出来给谁看?——该让正主看看了。
shots.visual: Over-the-shoulder shot: hands holding a smartphone showing the finished animated portrait video, warm living-room light, slightly shallow depth of field, the phone screen glowing as the only bright element, cinematic warm tones
shots.motion: Slow push-in toward the phone screen, screen light gently flickering as the video plays; narration pauses one beat before the second half

shots.narration: 奶奶看到二十岁的自己动起来,先是愣住,然后笑了,眼角有点湿。那一刻我明白:技术是壳,亲情才是核。你家抽屉里,是不是也有这样一张照片?
shots.visual: Cinematic vertical shot of a Chinese grandmother in her 80s watching a phone, soft window daylight on her face, authentic documentary style, her expression shifting from stunned stillness to a warm tearful smile, gentle skin texture, emotional and intimate framing
shots.motion: Real-reaction feel: slight handheld camera sway, slow motion on the moment she smiles; end card fades in with the golden quote "技术是壳,亲情是核" and closing question as caption
